ONNX Runtime Web 1.31.1 WASM-only browser bundle, taken from the official npm package `onnxruntime-web`.

Files included: `ort.wasm.min.js`, `ort-wasm-simd-threaded.mjs`, and `ort-wasm-simd-threaded.wasm`. The application configures the MJS/WASM paths explicitly. Package metadata: https://www.npmjs.com/package/onnxruntime-web (MIT). The upstream license is preserved in `LICENSE`.
